problems_addressed.solution_summary: Implement a backup editor and maintain a video bank to ensure content consistency.

episode_summary: Sarah Maslowski shares her insights on building a successful real estate business through YouTube by maintaining content consistency and implementing robust systems. She emphasizes the importance of having a backup editor and a video bank to ensure uninterrupted content flow. The episode provides actionable strategies for content planning and filming, offering valuable lessons for real estate agents looking to leverage YouTube for lead generation.
